create_GPTJForCausalLM: create a GPT-J causal language model for inference with vLLM using HuggingFace weights
build_GPTJModel: build the transformer backbone of GPT-J with embedding, attention blocks, and layer normalization
run_GPTJAttention_forward: run GPT-J attention forward pass with position IDs and hidden states to compute attention output
run_GPTJMLP_forward: run GPT-J MLP forward pass applying feed-forward linear layers with activation on hidden states
review_GPTJBlock_forward: review GPT-J block forward pass combining layer norm, attention, MLP, and residual connection
